declarations.name: Lemma D1. Canonical coprime lifts and class-defined lifts
declarations.scope: For finite central extensions, elements of order coprime to the central kernel have unique same-order lifts. Conjugacy-equivariant class sections give braid-invariant lifted products with a fixed infinity lift. In stem class-splitting extensions these are reduced Schur invariants. Pullbacks use orders of quotient images, and require a separate stemness argument.

declarations.name: Proposition D2. The involution-family partition is intrinsic class data
declarations.scope: In the complete two-bundled-involution/simple family, the actual embedded group and intrinsic G-branch classes already classify components. The degree partition is visible in the smaller bundled factor's two quotient fixed-point returns. In particular the same-group S_p-wr-C2 family consists of different Nielsen data, not a demonstrated lifting split. For p5 the relevant G-classes have sizes30 and100.

declarations.name: Theorem D3. A transposition kills the reduced multiplier of \(S_N\)
declarations.scope: For every N>=4, any branch-class list in S_N containing the transposition class has zero reduced Schur multiplier. Disjoint transpositions yield the nontrivial commutator in either Schur cover and kill H2(S_N)=C2. This rules out this source of separation but asserts no primitive connectivity.

declarations.name: Theorem D4. The seven-sheet split is a cubic reduced lifting split
declarations.scope: For A7 with DT and fixed seven-cycle infinity classes, the reduced multiplier is exactly C3. The2part is killed by a commuting Klein-four spin commutator, while all relevant orders are coprime to3. Complete392-tuple enumeration gives cubic values neutral98, z147,z^-1 147; the two nonzero sets are the two same-group A7 components, and the neutral set is the two distinct embedded PSL3(2) components49 each.

declarations.name: Theorem D5. A cubic area invariant explains the eight-sheet coupling
declarations.scope: The two degree8 H=parity-kernel components of L8 have the same intrinsic factor classes (sizes72 and36). The quotient H->F3^2 semidirect C4 and its explicit Heisenberg central C3 extension give a class-splitting stem pullback of order1728. Its canonical lifted products are the two nonzero cubic values and exactly separate these two16-tuple components. The entire reduced multiplier of H is not computed.

declarations.name: Theorem D6. An infinite family with identical intrinsic classes
declarations.scope: For every b>=2, the block-size-b sector of passport(2^(2b)1^(3b))^3,(b1^(6b)) has two same embedded C_b-wr-A7 components with identical intrinsic branch classes. Pulling back3.A7 through the quotient supplies a stem class-splitting C3 extension separating them by z and z^-1. This includes3|b through canonical quotient-image sections. Counts4116 literal/588 absolute and deck b are retained from L7; other sectors are excluded explicitly.

declarations.name: Theorem D7. A primitive three-value quadratic lifting split
declarations.scope: A strict cycle partition with a positive even number of even cycles is lift-split over its alternating-group class: the spin centralizer commutator is the ordinary sign character. In degree15, passport(5,4,3,2,1),(3 1^12),(3 1^12) has exactly two full8100-tuple components, same literal A15 and same intrinsic classes, trivial deck and absolute540 each. A specified split lift class for the order60 factor and unique odd-order lifts for the3cycles/infinity give opposite quadratic invariants. This is a genuine primitive genus0 three-value split, outside the index-two mixture theorem.
